review_candidates.title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer
review_candidates.description: Req ID:527799 At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signaling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars. Could you be the full-time Senior Cybersecurity engineer in Egypt we’re looking for? Your future role Take on a new challenge and apply your Cybersecurity Architecture expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside passionate, motivated, and dedicated teammates. You'll play a key role in ensuring the security of Alstom solutions by conducting security analyses, defining security requirements, and designing resilient architectures. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (engineering, project management, and technical experts), perform risk assessments, and contribute to the implementation of cybersecurity measures, and much more. You’ll specifically take care of delivering turnkey projects that align with contractual requirements and customer expectations, but also ensure compliance with Alstom’s cybersecurity strategy and policies. We’ll look to you for: Performing risk analyses in line with IEC 62443-3-2 and IEC 62443-3-3 standards Defining and managing cybersecurity architecture at the system level Conducting cybersecurity design reviews Ensuring the implementation of cybersecurity controls in designs Delivering requested cybersecurity-related documentation on time and with high quality Aligning solutions with Alstom’s cybersecurity strategies and policies Designing and documenting reliable security architectures resilient against cyber threats Updating and upgrading delivered solutions to maintain cybersecurity standards Guaranteeing technical cybersecurity coverage for contractual requirements Leading and contributing to cybersecurity risk assessments and requirement implementation Providing technical guidance and supervision for project teams Supporting engineering teams in addressing design and technical challenges related to cybersecurity Ensuring homogeneous cybersecurity implementation across projects All About You We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role: A university degree in engineering or a related field Experience with architecture, design, and development responsibilities Strong knowledge of the IEC 62443 standard Experience in cybersecurity, including deploying security technologies Understanding of key cybersecurity standards and regulations such as ISA/IEC 62443 and TS 50701 Familiarity with OT (Operational Technology) system architecture Knowledge of cybersecurity risk assessment methodologies, such as ISO 27005 and IEC 62443 Expertise in defense-in-depth techniques, including: Network security architecture development Perimeter security controls (e.g., firewalls, IDS/IPS, network access controls, segmentation) Security concepts related to DNS, routing, VPNs, and proxy services Ability to design and document robust cybersecurity architectures (e.g., zoning, services) Experience with system security evaluation techniques and intrusion testing Strong interpersonal skills to explain and enforce security measures across diverse teams Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also: Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from monotonous routines Work with cutting-edge security standards for rail signalling Collaborate with cross-functional teams and supportive colleagues Contribute to innovative and impactful projects Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries Benefit from our investment in your development through award-winning learning opportunities Progress towards leadership roles or technical specialist positions Enjoy a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, along with comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension) You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you! Important to note As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

review_candidates.description: Company: INEOS Olefins & Polymers USA Job title: Operational Technology (OT) Server Engineer Offer Range: $104,910 - $156,300 (commensurate with experience) Location: Alvin, Texas Interested in joining a winning team? A team whose employees are empowered to make a difference? Organizational Context And Job Purpose The Olefins & Polymers USA division of INEOS is one of the largest producers of olefins and polyolefins in North America. From its manufacturing locations at Chocolate Bayou and the Battleground Manufacturing Complex, it is a merchant marketer of butadiene, ethylene, polypropylene and high-density polyethylene with annual revenue of over $4B. The Chocolate Bayou Site is located in Southeastern Texas about 40 miles South of Houston and consists of two Olefins units that produce approximately 4bn pounds/year of ethylene, 2 Polypropylene units that produce approximately 1B pounds/ year of polypropylene, and the Light Ends storage & transfer facilities at Stratton Ridge. How The Role Fits In The OT Server Engineer is responsible for the availability, reliability, and cybersecurity of servers and core infrastructure that support industrial control systems (ICS) and plant operations. This role focuses on lifecycle management of OT servers (physical and virtual), patching, backup/restore, disaster recovery, performance monitoring, and secure integration with DCS/SCADA/Historians, while adhering to industrial cybersecurity standards (e.g., ISA/IEC 62443) and plant safety protocols. This position interfaces with Operations, Maintenance Capital Projects, Process Safety, Reliability and Mechanical Integrity Groups to ensure appropriate alignment in the delivery and sustainability of PLC & OT device security at all three manufacturing sites. This position reports to the Operational Technology Team Leader, part of the Process Control and OT organization. Responsibilities And Accountabilities The position is accountable for understanding and putting into practice the INEOS 20 Principles. Accountability: Server & Compute Infrastructure Maintenance Build, configure, and maintain OT servers in segmented OT networks Manage virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere/ESXi, Nutanix) and storage (SAN/NAS) supporting ICS applications. Maintain domain services (AD DS/OU/GPO design for OT), DNS/DHCP, NTP, and certificate services for OT trust boundaries. Health monitoring and alerting of server/computer equipment failures, alarms and warnings Establish and maintain KPIs for asset health, lifecycle and performance New server equipment installations and old equipment decoms User management for servers/workstations and remote access Implement IT and cybersecurity policies to meet Cybersecurity guidelines (IGGNs) Operational Technology (OT) server/system SME for all cybersecurity projects Support the site Digital System Specialists and Application Engineers in the selection, installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of their DCS servers and workstations Perform audits on all assigned process control networks and apply patches / keep system to date and maintain high availability Ensure initial configuration, upgrades and migrations of cybersecurity related software and hardware are working as planned (Anti-virus, Whitelisting, Backup and Restore, Monitoring Tools, Firmware and Patches, etc.) Assist with the design and implementation of disaster recovery and business continuity plans, procedures and audits Support all phases of assigned capital projects including equipment selection, installation, configuration, start-up, checkout, and supervision of personnel contracted for computer/server equipment installation. Responsible for identifying reliability issues and recommending solutions for system improvements. Able to support the OT Network Engineer with cisco equipment, firewalls and other network gear when needed. Education And/or Experience Education Bachelor’s degree related to Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology Minimum of 5 years of operational support experience in enterprise and/or OT infrastructure supporting chemical manufacturing/plant operations Working knowledge of information security standards, frameworks, risk assessment and best practices from ISA99, IEC62443, NIST882. Key Skills And Competencies Are Client Service Oriented, Skilled in partnering with internal customers at all levels to define problems, identify solutions, and facilitate change Impact and influence - able to persuade others to a particular course of action Teamwork - shares accountability for team results and utilizes interpersonal skills to improve team performance Analytical and conceptual thinking - able to understand both the details and the underlying systemic issues to plan and implement creative and effective solutions to business challenges Innovative and information seeking - monitors internal and industry trends to identify new opportunities. Organizes work effectively and uses available resources Anticipate problems and adjust accordingly Demonstrated ability to manage progress and deliver on multiple and competing priorities. Ability to manage multiple projects, activities and tasks simultaneously Experience with data protection, business continuity and disaster recovery options, configuration and execution Experience with support of IT/OT systems, including network implementation & segmentation, PLC's and field devices, and IT systems preferred Possess knowledge on Cisco Networking & Virtualization platforms such as VMWare, VXRail, vSAN and NSX. Willingness to learn and develop new skills Our culture is one of honesty and integrity with an emphasis on safety, health and environmental performance. On our team, people are acknowledged for embracing new practices that help create real value for customers.

review_candidates.title: DATACENTER ARCHITECT L3
review_candidates.description: Job Description Job Description Role: Data Center Transformation Architect Role Overview We are seeking a Data Center Transformation Architect to be deployed within a customer environment to lead and support their data center transformation journey end-to-end —from strategy and planning through target-state design, migration planning, governance, and execution oversight . The architect will act as the customer’s trusted technical leader, ensuring the transformation is technically sound, secure, resilient, compliant, and operationally adoptable , while coordinating across multiple technology towers and delivery teams. Key Responsibilities Strategy, Assessment & Planning Lead current-state assessments across compute, storage, network, virtualization, backup, DR, monitoring, and operational processes. Define transformation strategy and roadmap, including guiding principles, standards, target-state options, and phased execution plan. Translate business drivers (cost, resilience, regulatory requirements, exit/refresh timelines) into architecture priorities and delivery plans. Develop capacity and demand planning inputs (growth forecasts, constraints, critical workloads, performance baselines). Target-State Architecture & Design Ownership Own end-to-end DC target architecture, including: Compute platforms, HCI (where applicable), standard builds Storage strategy (SAN/NAS/Object, tiering, replication, backup integration) Network/DC fabric design (segmentation, routing, HA patterns, load balancing) Virtualization and platform modernization (VMware/Hyper-V/KVM; container readiness) Security architecture alignment (segmentation, controls, hardening, IAM integration) Resilience and DR architecture (fault domains, HA design, RPO/RTO mapping) Produce and govern architecture deliverables: HLD/LLD, reference architectures, design decisions, and patterns. Ensure designs are aligned to operational supportability, including monitoring, patching, backup, DR drills, and incident/problem processes. Migration & Transition Architecture Define migration approach and patterns (rehost/replatform/refactor where applicable). Create migration factory design inputs: wave planning, dependency mapping, cutover runbooks, rollback plans, and risk mitigations. Partner with application teams to validate workload suitability, downtime constraints, and sequencing. Ensure service continuity through cutovers, failover testing, and stabilization activities. Architecture Governance & Delivery Assurance Establish architecture governance: design reviews, checkpoints, technical risk management, and exception handling. Act as the final authority for technical decisions, ensuring adherence to standards and non-functional requirements. Guide multiple delivery streams (compute/storage/network/security/operations) to ensure integrated outcomes. Perform ongoing technical assurance: validate build quality, configuration compliance, performance, and resilience readiness. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration Serve as primary technical interface with customer stakeholders: Infrastructure leadership, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Operations, and Vendors. Communicate architecture trade-offs clearly (risk, cost, time) and maintain transparent decision logs. Coordinate with OEMs/partners where required for design validation, compatibility, and escalation. Documentation & Knowledge Transfer Maintain customer-ready documentation: target architecture packs, design decisions, standards, operational handover artefacts. Support knowledge transfer into customer operations and managed services teams, ensuring smooth transition to steady state. Required Skills & Experience Strong experience in infrastructure / data center architecture, with proven delivery ownership of large-scale DC transformation programs. Strong practical expertise across: Compute (x86), standard builds, lifecycle/refresh planning Storage architecture (SAN/NAS/Object), replication, backup integration, performance sizing Networking in DC environments (segmentation, HA, DC fabric concepts) Virtualization (VMware strongly preferred) and platform modernization DR/BCP design and testing practices (RPO/RTO engineering) Proven ability to create strategy + roadmap and translate into implementable designs. Strong delivery mindset: ability to work in complex environments with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. Excellent documentation and communication skills, including executive-level narrative and technical depth. Preferred / Good-to-Have Experience in regulated environments (pharma), audit readiness, and security control alignment. Exposure to hybrid connectivity patterns and integration with cloud landing zones. Working knowledge of automation/IaC concepts (Ansible/Terraform) and standardized build pipelines. ITIL/ITSM familiarity and operational model design (monitoring, patching, CMDB, change governance). Certifications (nice to have): VMware (VCP/VCAP), TOGAF, Cisco (CCNP), ITIL, OEM certifications.

review_candidates.title: Virtual Desktop Engineer
review_candidates.description: Quantum Sky is searching for a Senior Citrix Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) Engineer to support design, implementation, administration, optimization, and support of enterprise Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops environments. This senior-level role provides technical leadership for the organization's virtual desktop infrastructure, ensuring high availability, security, scalability, and performance across on-premises environments. The Senior Citrix VDI Engineer collaborates with systems engineers, network engineers, cybersecurity teams, application owners, and project managers to deliver secure, resilient, and efficient virtual desktop and application services. The position serves as the technical lead for VDI infrastructure projects, lifecycle management, troubleshooting, automation, and disaster recovery planning. Responsibilities: Design and architect the Citrix enterprise VDI solution for scalability, performance, and resiliency Lead at-scale VDI deployments, migrations, and platform upgrades Optimize VDI environments for cost, performance, and user experience (density, compute resource allocation, storage I/O) Establish standards for image management, application delivery, and security within the VDI environment Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex, high-impact VDI incidents Mentor mid-level engineers and collaborate with security teams on VDI hardening and compliance Evaluate emerging end-user computing technologies and recommend roadmap changes Required: Bachelor’s Degree required (experience and education equivalents are considered and can be substituted for a Bachelor’s Degree). 10 years of general work experience / 8 years relevant “functional” experience in end-user computing/VDI engineering Advanced certification preferred (Citrix CCP-V, VMware VCP-VCF) Deep expertise in VDI architecture, application virtualization, and performance tuning at scale Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide VDI programs or migrations Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with server, network, storage, and security teams Desired: Experience with a Citrix VDI environment Experience with a VMware ESXi, vCenter virtual infrastructure Experience with enterprise management of Dell Wyse Thin-Clients Experience with peripherals such as printers, scanners, card readers in VDI environment Experience with network attached storage and protocols such as NFS and CIFS Clearance: An active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility is required. Location and Schedule: This position is onsite at the customer location in Washington, DC. The environment requires onsite support five days per week, with some flexibility in scheduling based on program and customer requirements. Core business hours are 8am-4pm.

review_candidates.title: IT Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Airbound Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today. This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day. The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch. To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible. About the Role We're hiring our first dedicated in-house IT Support Engineer to own day-to-day IT operations across the company from keeping every laptop and application running smoothly, to helping us build a more secure, resilient IT environment as we scale. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role: you'll be the go-to person for ~140 end-user systems (Windows and Mac), our Google Workspace environment, office networks across two sites, and a growing set of security controls (endpoint protection, firewall, single sign-on, and more) that we're rolling out over the next few months. You'll work closely with an external Cybersecurity & GRC consultant during the initial rollout phase and take ownership of ongoing operations once controls are in place. Key Responsibilities End-user support Be the first point of contact for all IT issues, hardware, software, connectivity, and access across Bengaluru and Guntur Set up, configure, and maintain laptops/desktops (~90% Windows, ~10% Mac) for new joiners and existing staff Maintain a basic IT asset inventory (devices, licenses, warranties) Network & infrastructure Maintain and troubleshoot office network infrastructure, including wireless access points across both sites Support the rollout and ongoing management of firewall infrastructure and backup internet connectivity Liaise with ISPs and hardware vendors for installations, upgrades, and issue resolution Security operations (in partnership with our GRC consultant) Deploy and maintain endpoint protection (AV/EDR) across all systems Administer single sign-on (SSO) and manage access provisioning/de-provisioning across business applications Implement and enforce USB/device control policies Support periodic access reviews and basic security hygiene checks (patching, password policies, MFA) Workplace systems Administer Google Workspace (user accounts, groups, shared drives, permissions) Support AWS-related access requests in coordination with engineering (no infrastructure ownership expected) Maintain documentation for common IT processes, so support isn't dependent on one person's memory Qualifications Must-Have 3–5 years of experience in an IT support, systems administration, or helpdesk engineering role, ideally in a small-to-mid-sized company where you owned the function end-to-end Hands-on experience supporting both Windows and Mac environments Working knowledge of Google Workspace administration Basic networking fundamentals (Wi-Fi, firewalls, VPNs, troubleshooting connectivity issues) Exposure to endpoint security tools (antivirus/EDR) and access management concepts, deep security expertise not required, willingness to learn and follow a consultant-designed framework is Comfortable being the sole on-the-ground IT person, self-directed, methodical, good at triaging and prioritizing Clear communicator who can support non-technical colleagues patiently and without jargon Willingness to travel periodically to field operations Good to Have Prior experience in a manufacturing, hardware, or field-operations environment Familiarity with AWS basics (IAM users, S3 permissions) Experience with MDM tools or device management platforms Work location: Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters) | With periodic travel to field operations in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh) What We Offer Comprehensive health & life insurance to keep you and your loved ones covered Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend to ease your commute Advanced salary credit to support you when you need it “A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive - this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful from the ground up” Work Schedule: In-office role, working alternate Saturdays. Ready to take off?
